rationale: Y directly echoes more of the actual reviewer thread: it opens by flagging both Buildkite gates as red (matching hsliuustc0106/Gaohan123's CI-failure question), scrutinizes the exact max_duration_seconds guard placement relative to the early-return/rank branch (closely related to yuanheng-zhao's hang-risk comment), and credits the workdir cleanup. X's evidence-heavy audit is thorough and well-grounded but its closest hits (a cut-off aside about the rank-world test and a fixture-size critique) are weaker echoes of the human concerns, and it never clearly surfaces the CI-red issue. Both are well-grounded and actionable with specific file/line citations and concrete fixes, but Y's substantive findings (silent reference truncation, double-decode/view-retention, T2VA coverage loss) map more tightly to what actually mattered in review, giving it materially higher recall for comparable precision.
